notes.title: RUSSIAN UPDATE!
notes.notes:
RUSSIAN UPDATE!
Added Russian language, you can turn it on in the main menu settings!

Moreover, a lot of smaller things were added to the game! 

 Stormy sea at the final battle.
 Scene with roses.
 Fixed battle with 2-nd cultist.
 Obsessive dogs now recieve less damage from chain-ball
 Crash fixes.
 Minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: 1.0.4. Version is now available!
notes.notes:
Bug fixes!

Fixed crashes at the beacon room.
Pausing is now available at the very first room.
Added door at the last library room.
Fixed camera in battle against Imleer.
Minor bug fixes.
